Touch anywhere and pull back to aim, lik: Touch anywhere and pull back to aim, like a slingshot. The dotted line shows where the cat will go; let go to fling it. How do I open more levels and worlds?: How do I open more levels and worlds?
Win a level to open the next one. Each n: Win a level to open the next one. Each new world opens once you've earned enough stars in the levels before it; the level list shows how many you need. Go back to earlier levels for more stars at any time.
After a miss you can ask for one more ca: After a miss you can ask for one more cat. Lose a level twice and paw prints show a first throw that works; the rest is up to you, and every level can be beaten. Tap the round arrow at the top to start a level over. Sometimes a wild idea works too: bounce off a wall, knock something into place, or call megachonk.
A very large cat who arrives in his own: A very large cat who arrives in his own cat-a-pult. From kitchen 4 on, tap his button while you aim to call him once per level. He costs some of your saved-up money (the hooman's bill), and everything he breaks counts. Sometimes he's exactly what a level needs. Sometimes he sits on the wrong box.
